subject: Welcome to the University - Staff Account Created
body:
Dear $first_name $last_name,

Welcome to the University! Your staff account has been successfully created.

Here are your account details:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Username: $username
Email: $email
Role: $role
Temporary Password: $temp_password
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

IMPORTANT: For security purposes, please change your password upon first login.

Getting Started:
- Log into the system using your username and temporary password
- Update your profile and contact information

Useful Contacts:
- IT Helpdesk: it.help@$email_domain
- HR Department: hr@$email_domain
- General Inquiries: info@$email_domain

We look forward to working with you!

Best regards,
University Administration Team
